translations.web: God is to us a God of deliverance. To Yahweh, the Lord, belongs escape from death.
translations.bsb: Our God is a God of deliverance; the Lord GOD is our rescuer from death.
translations.kjv: He that is our God is the God of salvation; and unto GOD the Lord belong the issues from death.
